calc.title: Infrastructure fee calculator
calc.subtitle: Engineering-communication and transport infrastructure fee for construction
calc.intro: Mainly 3 things are needed: construction location, total building volume (from project documents) and object type. If there is parking, technical rooms, etc. — enter them too (otherwise 0). The result updates below.
calc.zoneHelp: If not detected from the map, choose by population
calc.xbHelp: Total construction volume from the project documents. E.g.: 12 000
calc.xyuLabel: Volume above the permitted number of floors
calc.xyuHelp: Volume of the part above the set number of floors. If none, leave 0
calc.deductNote: If the following parts are inside the total building volume, they are deducted from the fee. If there is no such part, leave 0.
calc.xaHelp: Volume of the parking inside the building
calc.xtHelp: Volume of technical floors, structures and rooms
calc.xuHelp: Volume of the common-use part of a residential building
calc.kzhLabel: What kind of street is the object on?
calc.kzhHelp: On a main/central busy street or an inner (mahalla) street? On a central street the fee is full, on an inner one it is lower.
calc.emptyHint: Enter the total building volume above.
calc.negativeWarn: Deducted parts exceed the total volume — volume taken as 0.
calc.disclaimer: The result is for reference. The official fee is calculated based on the expertise of the design-estimate documentation. Basis:
calc.kzAssumed: {name} — small settlement (Kz={kz}). Change manually if needed.
calc.koIndustrial: Industrial building (each floor up to 3 m)
calc.exemptTitle: Cases where the fee is not charged
calc.exempt1: Buildings given as compensation in renovation
calc.exempt2: Buildings handed over to the state free of charge
calc.exempt3: If 50%+ of the construction volume is handed to the state free of charge
calc.locMapHint: Click the construction site on the map — Kz is detected automatically.
calc.locErrResolve: Could not detect the location. Please try again.
calc.locErrKey: Yandex API key is not configured
calc.homeCtaDesc: Online calculation of the engineering-communication and transport infrastructure fee for construction per Resolution No.151.
